correctness.rationale: The full-branch critical maps satisfy the verified primary-source W2,1 Lasota--Yorke bound. Convexity yields one uniform contracting essential-radius estimate. Any unit-circle eigenfunction has stationary nonnegative modulus, made strictly positive by one positive-probability exact component; triangle equality on shrinking inverse cylinders forces constant phase, excluding all peripheral eigenvalues except simple 1. L1 contraction excludes Jordan chains and expanding eigenvalues. Resolvent continuity over the compact mixing interval yields uniform decay and analytic invariant densities. Symmetric inverse-branch Peano expansion verifies global boundary-jet formula. Exact fraction checker independently corroborates coefficient algebra but is not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete classification across all Bernoulli mixture probabilities, including intermediate values where local perturbation theory from either endpoint offers no conclusion. Uniform global convergence excludes interior loss of mixing and supplies common statistical control. It makes the explicit boundary-jet identification globally valid, rather than only infinitesimally local. No optimal mixing constant or wider family is claimed.
